verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਸਨਾ ਕੋ ਬਾਸੁ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਕਾਲ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: baasanaa ko baas dhoot sa(n)gat binaas kaal charan kamal gur ek Tek paiee hai ||

en.bdb: He who has taken the refuge of the lotus-like feet of the True Guru, is freed from attraction of all other smells and involvement in the five vices.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੈਜਲ ਭਇਆਨਕ ਲਹਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਸਕੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰ ਸੰਪਟ ਕੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: bhaijal bhiaanak lahar na biaap sakai nij ghar sa(n)paT kai dhubidhaa miTaiee hai ||

en.bdb: The worldly waves of wants and desires cannot influence him anymore. Having engrossed himself in the Self, he has destroyed all type of duality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਬਿਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸਿ ਬਸਿ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aan giaan dhiaan simaran bisimaran kai prem ras bas aasaa manasaa na paiee hai ||

en.bdb: The black bee like lover of the lotus-feet of the True Guru, forgets all other type of knowledge, contemplations and incantations of meditations. He has destroyed all his wants and desires by virtue of his love for the lotus feet of the True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੩੩੬॥
verses.translit_en: dhuteeaa naasat ek Tek nihachal mat sahaj samaadh unaman liv laiee hai ||336||

en.bdb: A Sikh of the Guru who is lover of the lotus feet (of the Guru) sheds his duality. He remains absorbed in the refuge of the lotus feet. In the higher spiritual state, he is absorbed in the stable contemplation of the Lord. (336)
